delivery.outcome: Adopt the immutable wellmanifest/docs placement contract for Taskand without changing runtime behavior or creating a competing report standard.
nonGoals: Creating or rewriting wellmanifest/docs or wellmanifest/report
Moving private logs, secrets, receipts or snapshots into the repository
Repairing unrelated pre-existing documentation findings in this ticket
Changing active Taskand runtime behavior or ticket-018 panel work

architecture.decision: Bind Taskand to the existing wellmanifest/docs source revision and policy digest through the repository adoption file; let the trusted checker enforce canonical paths and metadata.
architecture.rollback: Revert the adoption file through the protected delivery process; retain durable docs and private recovery evidence.
